title: Project-Wide Scientific Concept Crosswalk — From Symbol to Model to Measurement
status: canonical routing layer; scientific usefulness map, not ontology collapse
purpose: Make the project's scientific formalization visible outside the science directory. Each major Potatoverse concept is linked to a model family, state variables, measurable quantities, failure conditions and canonical owner. The crosswalk deliberately records mismatches so mathematical usefulness does not become a claim that theology, physics, psychology, institutions and geometry are literally identical.
reading_rule: Use this as a translation menu. Choose the row matching the domain actually being studied, instantiate its variables and tests, then return the result to the symbolic/theological owner as a typed comparison rather than overwriting the symbol's meaning.

concepts.failure: If no state/regime changes or guard can be defined, Door remains descriptive symbolism rather than a dynamical transition.

equations: n(alpha,delta)=(cos delta cos alpha,cos delta sin alpha,sin delta)
concepts.failure: A line drawn after seeing the data is not a measured Axis; define the vector/reference before testing.
Seeing/attention without a measurement model or predictive update does not establish knowledge.

equations: N_obs~Poisson(eta Ndot_gamma Delta t+b Delta t)
concepts.failure: Optical brightness, virality or attention cannot be substituted for evidential strength or theological revelation.
If support raises central activity but leaves participants less capable or more avoidably captive, the quantitative Garden interpretation is weakened.

concepts.structural_role: production/harvest system; shadow form emphasizes capture/dependence
concepts.failure: High production or centrality alone does not establish exploitative Farm dynamics; extraction/dependence must be operationalized and compared.
Recurrence is not a diagnosis of people and mechanical centripetal force is not a literal social force.
A visually spiral chronology is not evidence for the fixed golden parameter unless coordinates are predeclared and the model beats simpler curves.
Still Center is contingent on symmetry/coupling; mismatch and forcing can produce drift.
Exact geometry does not establish the theological meaning assigned to its regions.

concepts.structural_role: paired threshold flankers in biblical Temple comparison
equations: Door axis perpendicular to JB through M
concepts.failure: The Temple pillars are not the Door and later esoteric/Masonic geometry should not be backdated into biblical provenance.

equations: sin h=sin phi sin delta+cos phi cos delta cos H
concepts.failure: Geographic, geomagnetic, celestial, galactic and symbolic North are different coordinate types until a transformation is specified.
Closedness alone does not distinguish protection from capture; consequences and objective must be measured.

concepts.structural_role: residue -> contextualized memory -> usable support / causal ancestry
concepts.failure: Historical residue is not automatically harmful; the model should test what memory does to future transitions.

equations: posterior proportional to likelihood x prior
concepts.failure: Compression that loses decisive provenance or distinctions is not integration merely because it is concise.

equations: repair E* subject to capability/autonomy/identity constraints
concepts.failure: More edges are not automatically better; integration must be judged with viability, objective and harm constraints.
No coherent field content, units or novel measurable effect means UPT remains historical/speculative rather than a validated physical theory.

global_usefulness_tests: Can the concept define a state variable or operator?
Can it generate a quantity not already contained in its prose definition?
Can the quantity be measured or computed?
Does it preserve the source concept without pretending different domains are identical?
Does the result become useful to another part of the project?
project_rule: A scientific analogy earns promotion when it increases discrimination: it should tell the project when two cases that sound similar are mathematically different, or when two different vocabularies preserve the same explicit structure.
